For people

Unsure how to use a tool? Ask AI. Try asking Codex, “Help me model a phone stand in the Frame window I have open.” If you’ve already started a model, save it and tell Codex where to find it.

For AI assistants

Start with app.describe and scene.inspect. Give each parallel task its own project file (.hash) and link parts with Instance → File. Save to share progress. Use scene.file.wait for updates. On conflict, keep the draft and review scene.file.changes.
